title: SciFusion: Physics-Guided Compositional Diffusion for Multimodal 3D Scientific Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30313v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing 3D generative approaches are typically developed for individual imaging modalities, requiring substantial modality-specific data and limiting their ability to exploit shared structure across scientific imaging domains. We present SciFusion, a multimodal framework for unified 3D scientific image generation built on a latent diffusion backbone, with two key contributions. First, we introduce a compositional conditioning scheme that factorizes each modality into domain, object, and contrast representations. Sharing these factors across related modalities enables knowledge transfer across heterogeneous imaging domains and allows the factors to be recombined at inference time to synthesize unseen domain-object-contrast compositions in a zero-shot manner. translated_title: SciFusion：面向多模态3D科学图像生成的物理引导组合式扩散方法
translated_abstract: 现有的3D生成方法通常针对单一成像模态开发，需要大量特定模态的数据，并限制了其跨科学成像领域利用共享结构的能力。我们提出了SciFusion，一个建立在潜在扩散主干之上的多模态统一3D科学图像生成框架，具有两项关键贡献。首先，我们引入了一种组合式条件化方案，将每种模态分解为域、对象和对比度表示。在相关模态之间共享这些因子，能够实现异构成像领域之间的知识迁移，并允许在推理时重新组合这些因子，以零样本方式合成未见过的域-对象-对比度组合。其次，我们融入了领域特定的物理信息目标：用于MRI的傅里叶频谱一致性、用于CT的Radon投影一致性以及多层衍射一致性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SciFusion提出了一种基于潜在扩散的多模态3D科学图像生成框架，通过将模态分解为域、对象和对比度因子实现跨模态知识迁移与零样本组合生成，并引入MRI傅里叶频谱一致性、CT Radon投影一致性等物理信息目标来提升生成的物理合理性。
en_tdlr: SciFusion is a latent-diffusion-based multimodal framework for unified 3D scientific image generation that factorizes modalities into domain, object, and contrast factors for zero-shot cross-modality composition, enhanced by physics-informed objectives such as Fourier spectral consistency for MRI, Radon projection consistency for CT, and multislice diffraction consistency.
